_note: The five clickable reactor parts. 'id' must match the SVG group id in index.html. 'materials' are keys in chains.json.

parts.label: High-temperature superconducting magnets
parts.description: Confine the plasma in compact tokamaks, using magnets wound from REBCO superconducting tape.

parts.label: Low-temperature superconducting coils
parts.description: Confine the plasma in ITER-style reactors. The superconductor is niobium-tin (Nb₃Sn).

parts.label: Divertor & first wall
parts.short: Faces the plasma, takes the heat
parts.description: The divertor and first wall face the plasma directly and take the heat. They are made with tungsten.

parts.label: Breeding blanket
parts.description: The breeding blanket breeds tritium fuel and absorbs neutrons. Tritium breeding needs enriched lithium-6; beryllium serves as a neutron multiplier.

parts.label: Vacuum vessel & structure
parts.description: The vacuum vessel and structure hold everything together. Shown here for contrast: specialty steels matter for supply, but this research has not found a major human rights hotspot at this stage.
